description: Self-hosted governed script execution provider evaluated behind the VAOS Automation & Integration Fabric.

licensing.model: Open-source/self-hostable platform; production deployment, script licensing and service-account policy require qualification.
licensing.notes: VAOS invokes only pre-approved script keys mapped to versioned Windmill paths. Inline or arbitrary script execution is outside AF-7 scope.

notes: Production qualification remains blocked until service-account scope, script-version governance, queue/backpressure, timeout/reconciliation, result retention, object-storage handoff, cancellation and cost/resource controls are evidenced.
